stories.title: Media, piloti del volo FlyDubai sarebbero uno dell'Oman e l'altro emiratino

en.title: FlyDubai flight pilots reportedly one from Oman and one Emirati
en.summary: Reports indicate the pilots of a FlyDubai flight were from Oman and the United Arab Emirates, differing from earlier claims that they were Ukrainian and Russian.

stories.title: 'Emergenza sul volo FlyDubai per una lite tra pilota russo e copilota ucraino'

en.title: Emergency on FlyDubai flight due to altercation between Russian pilot and Ukrainian co-pilot
en.summary: Media reports describe an emergency situation on a FlyDubai flight involving a confrontation between pilots, with allegations that one attempted to cause a crash.

stories.title: Il volo Dubai-Tel Aviv rischia di precipitare. Lite tra piloti, l’ipotesi: “Uno dei due voleva farlo schiantare”

en.title: Dubai-Tel Aviv flight risks crashing. Pilot altercation, hypothesis: one of the two wanted to crash it
en.summary: A FlyDubai flight with approximately 170 people on board made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after an incident involving the pilots. The airline reported that the co-pilot stabbed the captain, with investigators examining possibilities including sabotage or attempted suicide.

stories.title: Istat, maxi balzo dell’inflazione: 4,2% a settembre. Cala la fiducia di consumatori e imprese

en.title: Istat, major surge in inflation: 4.2% in September. Consumer and business confidence decline
en.summary: Italian inflation rose sharply to 4.2 percent in September, driven by a significant surge in energy prices. Industrial data showed a decline after three consecutive months of growth.

stories.title: Istat, a settembre cala fiducia di consumatori e imprese

en.title: Istat, consumer and business confidence falls in September
en.summary: Italian consumer and business confidence declined in September, with business sentiment falling after three months of growth.

stories.title: Il volo Dubai-Tel Aviv perde quota e devia in Arabia Saudita: la ricostruzione della rotta

en.title: Dubai-Tel Aviv flight loses altitude and diverts to Saudi Arabia: route reconstruction
en.summary: A Flydubai flight carrying approximately 180 passengers from Dubai to Tel Aviv declared emergencies and diverted to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. An Israeli official attributed the incident to a violent altercation between the two pilots, though passenger accounts and full details remain disputed.

stories.title: Volo Flydubai, l'aereo diretto a Tel Aviv viene deviato in Arabia Saudita

en.title: Flydubai flight, plane headed to Tel Aviv diverted to Saudi Arabia
en.summary: A Flydubai flight bound for Tel Aviv was diverted to Saudi Arabia after the airline reported a physical altercation occurred between the pilots in the cockpit.

stories.title: Inflazione, la mazzata di settembre: +4,2%, il balzo degli alimentari

en.title: Inflation, September's blow: +4.2%, the surge in food prices
en.summary: Italian consumer prices increased 4.2 percent year-on-year in September, with monthly growth of 0.7 percent driven significantly by rising food costs.

stories.title: Kaliningrad, l'exclave russa sul Mar Baltico tra la Polonia e la Lituania. Perché è importante

en.title: Kaliningrad, the Russian exclave on the Baltic Sea between Poland and Lithuania. Why it matters
en.summary: Tensions around Russia's Kaliningrad exclave have increased following the invasion of Ukraine and European countermeasures. Moscow has warned NATO that it is prepared to defend the region with its full arsenal.

stories.title: Volo FlyDubai, la ricostruzione di Tel Aviv: "Pilota ha cercato di far schiantare l'aereo"

en.title: FlyDubai flight, Tel Aviv reconstruction: "Pilot attempted to crash the plane"
en.summary: A Boeing aircraft traveling from Dubai to Tel Aviv with 174 passengers transmitted international emergency codes. Passengers reported the pilot was stabbed and the aircraft was in danger of crashing.

stories.title: Volo Dubai-Tel Aviv: una coltellata in cabina, piloti in borghese bloccano l'attentatore. Israele: “Evitato un altro 11 settembre”

en.title: Dubai-Tel Aviv flight: a stabbing in the cockpit, plainclothes pilots stop the attacker. Israel: "Another 9/11 averted"
en.summary: A FlyDubai aircraft on route from Dubai to Tel Aviv declared an emergency and landed in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. An incident involving a stabbing in the cockpit was reportedly prevented by off-duty pilots.

stories.title: Perché Putin minaccia attraverso Kaliningrad: cos’è l’exclave, e quanti missili (nucleari?) ci sono

en.title: Why Putin threatens through Kaliningrad: what the exclave is, and how many missiles (nuclear?) are there
en.summary: The article examines claims and assertions regarding Putin's nuclear rhetoric related to Kaliningrad and its military capabilities.

stories.title: Podcast: 18,5 milioni di ascoltatori e la scoperta passa dai social

en.title: Podcast: 18.5 million listeners and discovery passes through social media
en.summary: Podcasts have become an established part of daily life for Italians, integrated into commutes and work routines. The medium continues to grow its audience year-over-year.

stories.title: Patrik Jonsson (Eli Lilly): «Scienze della vita e terapie innovative. L’Italia investa sulla prevenzione»

en.title: Patrik Jonsson (Eli Lilly): "Life sciences and innovative therapies. Italy should invest in prevention"
en.summary: The Eli Lilly executive vice president urges Italy to prioritize preventive therapies and life sciences investments, noting that the United States and China are advancing while Europe risks losing competitive advantage.

stories.title: Produttività al palo per le Pmi

en.title: Productivity stalled for SMEs
en.summary: A Cerved analysis covering 2019-2025 shows Italian small and medium enterprises increased in number and employment but experienced declining productivity levels.

stories.title: Accordo tra Tarros e Nurminen per nuovo corridoio intermodale Italia-Svezia

en.title: Agreement between Tarros and Nurminen for new Italy-Sweden intermodal corridor
en.summary: Italian company Tarros and Finnish logistics firm Nurminen have signed a commercial and operational agreement to establish a new intermodal transport corridor connecting Sweden and Italy.

stories.title: 24Ore Podcast, l’autunno si accende fra geopolitica, economia e cronaca

en.title: 24Ore Podcast, autumn heats up between geopolitics, economy and current events
en.summary: 24Ore Podcast, the audio platform hosting productions from Radio 24 and Il Sole 24 Ore, continues its growth trajectory across the media group's various divisions.
